original_value: In this work, we proposed a DDI detection method based on molecular structures using graph convolutional networks and deep sets. We proposed a more discriminative convolutional layer compared to conventional GCN and achieved permutation invariant prediction without losing the capability of capturing complicated interactions.

result.paraphrase: In this study, we present a DDI detection approach grounded in molecular structures and built with graph convolutional networks and deep sets. Compared with conventional GCN, we introduce a more discriminative convolutional layer and obtain permutation-invariant predictions while retaining the ability to capture complex interactions.
